title: Rollout last-mile scratchpad
content:
Context: personal scratchpad for today’s roll (can be messy). Target window: 2026-03-13 09:30-11:00 PT. Primary goal: cut traffic to 2.1 serving pool, validate latency under 120ms p95, verify no customer-facing 5xx spikes. Secondary: finish backport for metrics schema, ensure rollout config uses canary 10% then 50% then 100% if green.

Preflight (done/to-check):
- [x] Confirm smoke model artifacts available in S3 bucket: s3://redwood-releases/2026-03/fastpath-v2/sha-abc123
- [x] DB migration queued (migration id: RL-MIG-2026-03-13-01) -- preflight ran on staging at 03/11 22:00 PT
- [ ] Ensure infra team has standby GPUs for Dedicated (ask @Ethan)
- [x] Canaries defined in rollout config: canary->progression->fallback
- [x] Pager duty oncall pinned in rollout doc (SRE: Priya R., Eng: Me)

Quick timeline (my notes):
- 09:00 PT — arrive, caffeinate, open dashboards (model-latency, request-errors, tailsampler)
- 09:15 PT — sync with SRE (Priya) and Ethan in #releases->confirm traffic steering plan
- 09:30 PT — start canary 10% (route via routing-policy=fastpath-canary)
  - watch p95, error-rate, token-cost per request
- 09:45 PT — if green, progress to 50% (manual, 3m observation at each step)
- 10:00 PT — 100% if still green; if not, execute rollback plan below
- 10:15-11:00 PT — post-rollout sanity checks, schedule postmortem if any anomalies

Cutover commands (notes to self):
- Start canary: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/rollouts/start -d '{"name":"fastpath-v2","canary_percent":10}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $RELEASE_TOKEN"
- Increase: curl ... -d '{"canary_percent":50}'
- Finalize: curl ... -d '{"canary_percent":100}'
- Immediate rollback: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/rollouts/rollback -d '{"name":"fastpath-v2","to_version":"v1"}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $RELEASE_TOKEN"
- Direct traffic flip (manual emergency): kubectl set image deployment/serving fastpath=ghcr.io/redwood/fastpath:v1 --namespace=prod-serving && kubectl rollout status deploy/serving -n prod-serving

Health checks & dashboards to watch (quick links/queries I’ll paste in Slack):
- Grafana: dashboards/model-latency, infra/host-health, api/5xx-rate
- PromQL quick checks:
  - 5xx-rate: sum(rate(http_requests_total{status=~"5..",route="/v1/generate"}[1m])) by (instance)
  - p95 latency: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{route="/v1/generate"}[5m])) by (le))
  - KV cache hit ratio: sum(rate(kv_cache_hits_total[5m])) / sum(rate(kv_cache_requests_total[5m]))
- Tail-sampler (kinesis): watch for spikes in sample rate and large payloads

Backports / code items I still need to finish (personal dev TODO):
- RL-4821: metrics-schema backport to prod (branch: backport/metrics-schema-rl4821) - ensure unit tests for serde pass on py3.9
- PR: gh/pr/1258 — small change to batching window (needs rebase, conflicts in scheduler.go)
- Ensure integration test for cache-warmup included in nightly smoke

Stakeholders / comms (who to ping at each stage):
- Pre-cutover: ping #releases with short checklist, mention when I flip to 10% (tag @platform-ops)
- If anomaly: call out in #incidents and page oncall (SRE -> Priya R., seeding PD: +1 555-0102)
- Post-success: post a short summary in #releases and update CONFLUENCE-ENG/CUTOVER-RUNBOOK-2026 with final timing and notes

Rollback plan (fast):
- Trigger rollout rollback (API) -> monitors will alert
- If API rollback fails, manual image flip with kubectl (see commands above)
- For DB migration failure during roll: run rollback migration script: /scripts/db/rollback/2026-03-RL-MIG-01.sh (runbook: CONFLUENCE-ENG link)
- Escalation: page Engineering Manager (Meera) -> org-level comms if >15m outage and customer impact

Open questions / TODOs before go: 
- Who signs off on the final 100% step? (I think Meera wants to be personally pinged) — TODO: confirm 09:00
- Infra hot spares: Ethan to confirm GPU spare count for Dedicated (needed if node eviction during rollout)
- Billing note: confirm cost impact for increased KV cache prefill during canary (ask finance if >$5k/day)

Personal operator cheatsheet (copy-paste friendly):
- Check service health: curl -sS https://infra.redwood.dev/_health | jq .status
- Quick tail of pods: kubectl -n prod-serving logs -l app=serving -f --tail=200 | grep ERR
- List rollout history: curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $RELEASE_TOKEN" https://api.redwood.dev/v1/rollouts/history?name=fastpath-v2

After-release notes (what to record right after success/failure):
- Exact timestamps for 10/50/100 progression
- Any 5xx spikes with sample request ids (grab from tailsampler)
- Observed p95/p99 numbers and token-cost delta vs baseline
- Any customer reports / support tickets opened within 30m of cutover

Quick personal reminders:
- Bring backup laptop charger (seriously).
- Eat a snack during the 3m observation windows.
- If I get paged, do the 3-step: (1) ack (2) triage (logs/metrics) (3) escalate if not resolved in 10m.

Notes-to-self after the last dry run:
- Dry-run at 03/11 had a minor scheduler race — increased lock timeout in scheduler.go fixed it on staging; remember to watch for delayed OOMs on model-worker-2
- Tail-sampler sometimes misses long-tail requests due to sampling rate; add longer window (10m) when validating post-rollout

End of scratchpad — will tidy into runbook after the rollout (if time).
